summary: Hunter stranded in the Deep Lake area of the Flat Tops after his vehicle was stuck in drifted snow; GSAR reached him by snowmobile and transported him to staging at mile marker 11 on FS Road 600 (Coffeepot Road), uninjured
responding_agency: Garfield County Search and Rescue (Garfield County Sheriff's Office)
notes: Activated 11:30 AM 2024-11-08; 5 GSAR members with two 4-wd trucks and five snowmobiles; subject taken to Glenwood Springs to meet a friend; team returned to barn 8 PM same day.
